program:
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (5e-6, 2e-6, 12e-6),     # PTAT branch current at 27C
    "r21":    (9.6, 8.0, 11.5),        # R2/R1 -> PTAT gain (TC trim)
    "gmid_p": (14.0, 9.0, 16.5),       # PMOS mirrors: weak/moderate inversion -> low Vsg (headroom)
    "Lp":     (1.5, 0.5, 4.0),         # PMOS L (output resistance / line reg)
    "gmid_n": (20.0, 12.0, 25.0),      # OTA input pair, deep WI -> low Vgs keeps tail node up
    "Ln":     (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),
    "Iota":   (4e-6, 1.5e-6, 10e-6),   # OTA tail current (self-biased from pg)
    "Cc":     (3e-12, 0.5e-12, 10e-12) # dominant-pole cap pg->vdd (also PSRR)
}

NQ = 8  # PNP area ratio

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I, Io = p["I"], p["Iota"]
    lnN = math.log(NQ)
    R1 = UT * lnN / I
    R2 = p["r21"] * R1

    # PMOS mirrors (same gm/Id, L -> same Vsg; W scales with current)
    mp  = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I,      vds=0.9)
    mp4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Io,     vds=1.0)
    mpl = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Io / 2, vds=mp.vgs)
    # OTA NMOS input pair (gates at Veb ~0.55-0.87 V)
    mn  = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], Io / 2, vds=0.35)
    # tail mirror
    mt  = lut.size("n", 12, 2.0, Io, vds=0.25)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # core: PTAT generator + output branch
    n.dev("MP1", "a",   "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP2", "b",   "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP3", "vref","pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "a", m=1)
    n.R("R1", "b", "eb", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "eb", m=NQ)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)

    # self-biased OTA: tail mirrored from core PMOS gate line
    n.dev("MP4", "nb", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp4)
    n.dev("MN5", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MN6", "t",  "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # input pair: M1 gate A -> drain = output pg ; M2 gate B -> diode side
    n.dev("M1", "pg", "a", "t", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "b", "t", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("ML1", "d2", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", mpl)
    n.dev("ML2", "pg", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", mpl)
    n.C("Cc", "pg", "vdd", p["Cc"])

    # start-up: if vref low, sn high -> MS1 pulls pg low
    n.M("MS2", "sn", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 15.0)
    n.M("MS3", "sn", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 0.5)
    n.M("MS1", "pg", "sn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 0.5)

    # ---- predictions ----
    veb3 = 0.76 + UT * math.log(I / 10e-6)
    vptat = p["r21"] * UT * lnN
    vref = veb3 + vptat
    T0 = 300.15
    dveb = -(1.20 - veb3 + 3.5 * UT) / T0          # V/K
    slope = dveb + vptat / T0                       # residual linear slope
    curv = 3.5 * 8.617e-5 * 20.0                    # ~curvature box contribution (V)
    dv = abs(slope) * 165 + curv * 0.15
    tc = dv / (vref * 165) * 1e6
    istart = 1.0e-6
    power = 1.8 * (3 * I + 2 * Io + istart)
    gm_p = mp.gm
    rdiff = R1 - (UT / I) * (1 - 1.0 / NQ)
    a_ota = mn.gm / (mn.gds + mpl.gds)
    loop_gain = a_ota * gm_p * rdiff
    line_reg = (mp.gds / I) * vptat              # V/V, from MP3 CLM
    psrr = -db(line_reg + 1e-6)
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "power": power, "startup_ok": 1,
               "line_reg": line_reg, "psrr_1k": psrr, "loop_gain": loop_gain}
